verdict.rationale: Publishing a supported-browser matrix is a fair question for a UI framework, so the axis applies. No evidence item documents an official Svelte or SvelteKit browser matrix or polyfill guidance. The one community comment about the SvelteKit launch site asking users to avoid Safari is an anecdote about a website, not an official support policy, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I know the framework's officially supported browser matrix so I can plan polyfills or decide when to drop legacy support
